paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Abba. When his wife died, R' Elazar and R' Natan bar Abba went up to him: Jerusalem Talmud, Megallehin, end of halakhah 1. He asked before R' Assi. R' Bun bar Hiyya reports in his name. He asked R' Ze'ira, and R' Tanhum and the rabbis of Caesarea objected: Jerusalem Yevamot, chapter 10, halakhah 14, and Kiddushin, chapter 1, halakhah 2. R' Nahum objected. He said in R' Yohanan's name: Nazir 51a. “Many times I used to stand before R' Yohanan”: Megillah 27, beginning of side b; Avodah Zarah 35a. Rav Yosef was perhaps his brother. R' Yaakov bar Aha reports in his name: Jerusalem Pesahim, Ellu Devarim, beginning of halakhah 5. R' Natan bar Abba: see above. Rav Pappa transferred ownership of money to R' Shmuel bar Abba: Bava Kamma 104b. The rabbis of Caesarea: see above. Rav Sheshet said to him, “I shall explain it to you”: Eruvin 7b. R' Tanhum: see above.
